script.text: Who are you?
My name is Sherry LeBlanc, and I wanted to test how you handle pressure.
You have passed with flying colors.
I want you on my team. You and I will ride together in the World Grand Prix and win it all.
Oh yeah?
I simply must have you on my team.
Why?
If you must know Monsieur Fudo, I am driven by my hunger for revenge.
And I will stop at nothing until I have finally achieved it!
Against who?
Against an organization known as Iliaster. They kidnapped my parents when I was just a little girl.
I managed to escape their grasp and have spent my entire life on the run.
Iliaster? I heard that name from Goodwin’s brother Roman.
From the little I have gathered, they are a secret society with wild ideas about the universe.
They operate from the shadows, and they will do anything to get rid of those who stand in their way.
Which is why they came for my family.
I’m so sorry, Sherry...
Iliaster is pulling the strings behind the upcoming World Racing Grand Prix.
This is why I want more than anything to win. To get closer to them!
I must know what Iliaster did with my parents and what they’re planning to do. I must win this race.
And I know I can do so with you on my team.
There is a long road ahead, mon ami. Until next time, Yusei Fudo.
